prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss on the rear-end collision. Insured reports being stopped at a red light when the third-party vehicle struck the rear bumper. Police report requested. No injuries reported at scene by insured.

Entry 2: Contacted the third-party driver's carrier to confirm liability position. Carrier acknowledges coverage and is reviewing the file. Photos of both vehicles received and added to the claim.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Claimant reports neck strain and is starting physical therapy. Requested medical records and billing through counsel.

Entry 4: Reviewed repair estimate for the rear damage. Vehicle appraised as repairable. Rental coverage confirmed for the duration of repairs. Demand package from counsel expected once treatment documentation is complete.

Entry 5: Received treatment notes from the claimant's physical therapist indicating ongoing neck strain with improving range of motion. File flagged for follow-up in two weeks. Reserve reviewed and maintained pending receipt of the demand package.
